text: Start by choosing a bike with gears that suit your needs. Gears help you change the speed of your bike depending on the terrain and the distance you want to cover. Some bikes have more gears than others, so you can make the right choice based on your preferences and riding style. Once you've chosen your bike, don't forget to wear a helmet to protect your head from any unexpected falls or accidents. A well-fitted helmet will ensure that it stays in place while you ride, and can also help to absorb some of the impact in the event of a crash. With proper gear and a helmet, you can safely enjoy the thrill of cycling and explore the world around you.
